title: Fire Side meeting.
summary: A fantastic Fireside Meeting was hosted by Rtn. Hitesh Mehta and PE Rtn. Chetna Mehta to welcome and help new members get to know each other.
description: A fantastic Fireside Meeting was hosted by Rtn. Hitesh Mehta and PE Rtn. Chetna Mehta to welcome and help new members get to know each other. The evening brilliantly combined warm fellowship with exceptional hospitality, featuring amazing starters, drinks, a speechless-worthy main course, and delightful desserts that provided a sweet ending to the night until around 11:30 PM. New members came to understand Rotary and left praising both the organization and the five-star treatment, proving that such gatherings turn strangers into friends and friends into family. The special evening brought together esteemed members including President Rtn. Pprakash Kamthe, FL Preeya Kamthe, Vikrambhai, Harshav Bhabhi, Durgesh Ji, Pooja Ji, Vitthal Kalbate and spouse, Gemini Mehta and spouse, Kalpesh Dagli and spouse, and Jatin Mehta. New members shared unique and interesting self-introductions, while AG Rtn. DrAvinash Sonawane added immense value by sharing practical, informative insights about Rotary.
